d: Short, straight platinum white hair with bangs framing a youthful, mature face and sharp, glowing crimson eyes. A slender build wearing a white bustier under a black corset with a silver skull buckle, paired with a black mini-skirt, black thigh-high stockings with garter straps, and a long black cloak with a vibrant red lining and red piping.
